shots.visual_event: At midnight, brass rails grow down the centre of a modern rain-wet avenue; the Midnight Train emerges between buses and buildings.
shots.dialogue_audio: News voice: “A train is moving through the east district. There are no tracks.”

shots.visual_event: Nila drives barefoot, cracked hands fused to the clock controls, while stored memories orbit the engine like bottled stars.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “Every passenger gets a door home.”

shots.visual_event: Arin, Saira, and unmasked Elias race across the roof toward the engine as the city bends into overlapping years below.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “If the engine reaches Central, the debt reaches everyone.”

shots.visual_event: Meera, Maya, and quadruped Tick pursue in Maya’s tiny maintenance trolley along tracks forming seconds ahead of them.
One carriage door opens beside a hospital. A missing nurse steps out; across the street, a family simultaneously forgets why they are crying.
The train’s destination board changes in clean editorial type to CENTRAL STATION / LAST STOP / 12:13.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “Thirteen minutes until the city is emptied.”

end_card.text: THE LAST STOP IS THE WHOLE CITY
